name: privacyfold
description: 72 client-side document, image, developer and cryptography tools that run inside the browser tab. Two of them embed a WebAssembly engine (libheif, sql.js); the rest are plain JavaScript. There is no remote MCP server: this manifest is a descriptive tool schema, and each URL opens the tool with agent hooks (?mode=agent) so a driving agent can run it locally.

transport.note: No network transport. Run the tools in a browser; no user data is sent anywhere.

tools.task: Audit document heading hierarchy, alt text & reading order for ADA compliance

tools.title: Rewriter (rule-based)
tools.task: Tighten or restyle your writing
tools.description: Tightens wordy phrases, converts prose to bullets, formalises or simplifies it with a fixed rule set. Deterministic: the same text always gives the same output, nothing is sent to a model, and no download is needed.

tools.task: Convert cURL commands into JavaScript fetch() or Axios code locally
tools.description: Convert `curl` CLI requests (including headers, bearer tokens, and JSON bodies) into clean JavaScript `fetch()` or `axios` snippets without pasting private API keys into online converters.

tools.description: Generate crisp, vector SVG barcodes (Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A) locally in your browser with zero tracking pixels.

tools.description: Convert text to Base64 and back. Handles any language and emoji.

tools.task: Remove a flat background
tools.description: Flood-fills the border colour from the edges and makes it transparent, with a tolerance slider. Built for studio, product and document shots on a plain background — it is a colour-key cutout, not an AI matting model, and it will not trace hair.

tools.name: privacyfold.chat_pdf
tools.title: Chat with a document
tools.task: Answer questions from document text with local keyword retrieval
tools.description: Split pasted document text into passages, rank them against your question with BM25 keyword scoring, and quote the best passages with the score that found them. Retrieval is deterministic: you can see why a passage was chosen, and the answer is quoted rather than generated.

tools.name: privacyfold.clean_paste
tools.title: Smart clipboard & tracking scrubber
tools.task: Clean tracking tokens, UTM tags, and zero-width tracking characters from copied text
tools.description: When you copy and paste links or text from modern web pages, social media platforms, or marketing emails, tracking entities secretly embed surveillance markers into your clipboard. These include UTM campaign tags, Facebook click IDs (fbclid), Google click IDs (gclid), affiliate tracking tokens, and invisible zero-width unicode characters (such as zero-width spaces U+200B and word joiners U+2060) that can fingerprint your specific user account across applications. PrivacyFold's Smart Clipboard & Tracking Scrubber sanitizes copied links and prose entirely in client-side memory. It strips surveillance parameters, normalizes obfuscated characters, and emits pristine, privacy-clean text with zero tracking leakage.

tools.task: Minify HTML, CSS or JS and encode/decode HTML entities

tools.name: privacyfold.exif_strip
tools.title: Photo metadata & location remover
tools.task: Remove EXIF, GPS location, and camera serial metadata from photos
tools.description: Digital photos captured by modern smartphones and digital cameras embed invisible Exchangeable Image File Format (EXIF) metadata inside every file. This metadata frequently contains precise GPS latitude and longitude coordinates showing the exact location of your home, office, or children's school, along with camera serial numbers, device model, capture timestamps, exposure settings, and embedded thumbnail images. PrivacyFold's Photo Metadata Remover inspects the raw binary byte stream of your image directly in browser memory, parsing standard JPEG APP1 segments, PNG tEXt/eXIf chunks, and WebP EXIF containers, surgically eliminating every tracking marker before re-encoding or exporting the clean image. Zero bytes are uploaded to remote cloud servers, preserving total confidentiality.

tools.name: privacyfold.exposure_xray
tools.title: Exposure X-ray & redaction self-test
tools.task: See everything a file reveals before you share it
tools.description: Drop any photo, PDF, or text snippet to see what it gives away: GPS pins, camera serials, timestamps, author history, and hidden PDF text layers—plus a Redaction Self-Test proving 0 hidden words are recoverable.

tools.name: privacyfold.file_encrypt
tools.title: Zero-knowledge file encryptor & self-decrypting envelope
tools.task: Encrypt sensitive files with AES-256-GCM into self-contained HTML envelopes that decrypt offline
tools.description: When sharing sensitive financial statements, tax filings, legal contracts, or confidential identity documents, traditional cloud file-sharing services store your data unencrypted on their servers or hold the master decryption keys. PrivacyFold's Zero-Knowledge File Encryptor implements military-grade AES-256-GCM symmetric encryption combined with PBKDF2 key derivation using 600,000 SHA-256 iterations directly inside your browser via the W3C Web Cryptography API. Rather than requiring recipients to install proprietary decryption software, the tool packages your encrypted payload into a self-decrypting HTML envelope. Any recipient with the correct passphrase can open the HTML file in any modern web browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, or Android, enter the password, and decrypt the original file with zero software installations and zero network requests.

tools.name: privacyfold.hash_gen

tools.description: Create a SHA fingerprint of text or any file, to check that it has not changed.

tools.name: privacyfold.heic_to_jpg

tools.task: Convert an iPhone photo
tools.description: Open iPhone photos anywhere.

tools.name: privacyfold.image_compress
tools.title: Client-side image compressor
tools.task: Compress JPEG, PNG, and WebP images to exact target file sizes without quality loss
tools.description: Image compression is one of the most common file processing tasks on the web, yet virtually every existing online compression service forces users to transmit personal photos, business graphics, and sensitive scanned documents to remote cloud infrastructure. PrivacyFold's Client-Side Image Compressor re-engineers modern production-grade compression algorithms—including Mozilla's MozJPEG, Google's WebP, libpng, and AVIF—compiled directly into WebAssembly. This architecture enables industrial-strength compression with intelligent perceptual quantization, color subsampling, and binary size targeting to run entirely within your local browser sandbox. You can compress images to exact kilobyte limits (e.g. under 200 KB for portal forms) with zero server bills, zero bandwidth consumption, and guaranteed zero privacy leakage.

tools.name: privacyfold.passport_photo
tools.title: Biometric passport photo creator
tools.task: Crop and standardize biometric ID and passport photos to official government dimensions
tools.description: Applying for international passports, travel visas, permanent residency cards, and national identity credentials requires strict adherence to sovereign biometric photo specifications. Government portals routinely reject user uploads for minor non-compliance issues such as incorrect face-to-frame height ratios, non-compliant background luminance, improper head tilt, incorrect millimeter dimensions, or excessive file sizes. PrivacyFold's Biometric Passport Photo Creator provides an automated, client-side photographic studio directly in your browser. It includes pre-calibrated presets for over 87 international jurisdictions (including US State Department 2x2 inch, UK HM Passport Office 35x45mm, Schengen ICAO, Canada IRCC, Australia ImmiAccount, and UAE Golden Visa), allowing you to frame, crop, calibrate background lighting, and export print-ready 600 DPI sheets with absolute privacy and zero server uploads.

tools.description: Generate high-entropy random passwords or memorable multi-word XKCD passphrases using your browser’s cryptographic random source.

tools.task: Reduce PDF size for USCIS, UK Visa VFS, HMRC, or Email limits
tools.description: Compress PDF documents to meet strict government and email portal limits (USCIS I-130 <2 MB, UK Visa VFS <2 MB, HMRC SA100 <5 MB, Schengen VFS <5 MB, Court E-Filing <5 MB, Gmail <25 MB).

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_flatten

tools.task: Flatten interactive form fields so they cannot be edited
tools.description: Flatten interactive AcroForm fields, checkboxes, and signature appearances into static page content for IRS 1099, USCIS, and notary submissions.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_merge
tools.title: Private PDF merger & binder
tools.task: Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file in browser memory
tools.description: Combining confidential documents—such as tax returns, bank statements, employment verifications, and medical records—is a standard administrative requirement for visa, loan, mortgage, and legal applications. However, standard online PDF merge websites require you to upload your sensitive multi-page documents to their remote servers, exposing private financial and personal identity records to server log retention and potential cloud data breaches. PrivacyFold's Private PDF Merger combines, reorders, and binds PDF files entirely within your web browser's client-side memory using WebAssembly and pure client-side PDF object streaming. Your original PDFs never leave your machine, ensuring full compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, attorney-client privilege, and enterprise confidentiality requirements.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_metadata
tools.title: PDF metadata stripper
tools.task: Remove Author, Producer, Creator & revision history from PDFs
tools.description: Strip hidden /Author, /Creator, /Producer, /CreationDate, /ModDate, and XMP XML packets from PDF files before public release or legal filing.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_redact
tools.title: Destructive PDF redactor & blackout tool
tools.task: Permanently blackout and erase sensitive text, SSNs, and figures from PDF files
tools.description: Redacting sensitive information from legal filings, government FOIA requests, and corporate contracts requires true destructive removal of underlying data. A notorious failure mode in digital redaction involves placing black rectangles over sensitive text without deleting the underlying text stream—allowing anyone to select, copy, or search the hidden Social Security Numbers, names, or financial figures underneath. PrivacyFold's Destructive PDF Redactor permanently removes both the visual elements and the underlying content stream objects, vector paths, and metadata from the document structure. Running 100% locally in your browser, it ensures that classified and private information is mathematically eradicated before the document ever leaves your workstation.

tools.name: privacyfold.w9_prep
tools.title: IRS Form W-9 TIN & tax worksheet
tools.task: Calculate and prepare IRS Form W-9 contractor tax information locally
tools.description: When onboarding as an independent contractor, vendor, or freelancer in the United States, clients routinely request IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification). Form W-9 requires sensitive financial and personal data, including your full legal name, business entity classification (sole proprietor, LLC, C Corp, S Corp), address, and your Social Security Number (SSN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN). Using online PDF form fillers exposes your SSN—the primary credential for US identity theft—to commercial cloud databases. PrivacyFold's IRS Form W-9 Tax Worksheet allows contractors to format, validate, and calculate their W-9 data entirely inside local browser memory. No tax data is ever uploaded, ensuring complete compliance with IRS privacy guidelines and zero exposure of your SSN.
